snippet.title: Witchspire - Early Access Launch Date Reveal | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
A survival-crafting adventure in a world brimming with magic and peril. Befriend and battle creatures, and conjure up a sanctuary alongside other witches in co-op or single-player.

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
